item.title: ZeroDays Again
item.description:
I’ve seen people talking about ZeroDays again.

I genuinely don’t understand why people take those guys so seriously.

They’re skids.

That’s it.

I’ve watched people in that group spend hours talking themselves up over things that wouldn’t impress anyone who actually knew what they were doing. They seem to think using dramatic usernames and posting screenshots makes them some kind of elite group.

It doesn’t.

I normally wouldn’t bother mentioning them, but someone sent me a message asking if I was worried because apparently ZeroDays had been “looking into me”.

item.title: The Guy Who Kept Arguing
item.description:
Some people genuinely don’t know when to stop talking.

I was in a group chat tonight and one guy kept arguing with everyone about absolutely everything. Nothing serious. Just one of those people who has to correct every sentence somebody writes.

Eventually he started having a go at me specifically.

I told him to leave it.

He didn’t.

Then he started with the usual stuff about how nobody could possibly know who he was because he didn’t use his real name.
